description.text:
By the unique collection of neighbourhood bars, Darwin & Wallace

The perfect backdrop for socialising with seasonal serves, craft beers and house wines alongside scratch cooked, sustainable plates, to be shared with friends.

A lively all-day hangout, from Monday morning coffee to Friday evening nightcap; breakfast is served from 9am daily with all day brunch on the weekends featuring Caravan coffee, cold pressed juices, house eggs, breakfast rice bowls and tacos. Post work drinks will be soundtracked on Thursday and Friday evenings by DJs and for when drinks turn into dinner, small and sharing, virtuous or hearty dishes feature on the menu for whatever the occasion requires.

Inside, guests will find bright lounging areas, hand-made furniture and handpicked artwork.

Outside, a south-facing waterside terrace caters to 130 guests, perfect for after work drinks alfresco.

Private dining, drinks parties and exclusive hire options from 30 – 150 guests are available.
